paheli.question: What comes down but never goes up?

dialogue: Teacher: Did you copy your homework from your friend?
Student: No, I didn't!
Teacher: Then why does your notebook say 'I don't know the answer either'?
Student: Because we have the same thoughts!

prerak_kahani.title: The Woodcutter's Axe
prerak_kahani.story: A young woodcutter started a new job and chopped down 18 trees on his first day. The boss was impressed. But the next day he only chopped 15, and on the third day only 10, despite working harder. His boss asked, 'When was the last time you sharpened your axe?' The woodcutter realized he had been so busy chopping that he forgot to sharpen his tool.
prerak_kahani.moral: Hard work alone is not enough. You must also take time to improve your skills and 'sharpen your axe'.

word_of_the_day.meaning: Achieving maximum productivity with minimum wasted effort or expense.
word_of_the_day.example: The new manager implemented a more efficient system to complete the daily tasks.

today_in_history.fact: On October 1, 1958, the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) was officially established.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? Apples are actually more effective at waking you up in the morning than a cup of coffee.

quote_of_the_day.quote: Strive not to be a success, but rather to be of value.
quote_of_the_day.author: Albert Einstein

paheli.question: What gets bigger the more you take away from it?

dialogue: Boss: I'm letting you go, you are the worst employee I have ever seen.
Employee: Can I have a letter of recommendation?
Boss: Saying what?!
Employee: That I am the best at being the worst.

prerak_kahani.title: The Camel and the Baby
prerak_kahani.story: A baby camel asked its mother why they had humps, long legs, and thick eyelashes. The mother explained that humps store water for desert travel, long legs keep them away from the hot sand, and thick lashes protect their eyes from sandstorms. The baby thought for a moment and said, 'So we are perfectly designed for the desert. Then why are we in a zoo?'
prerak_kahani.moral: Your strengths and skills are only useful if you are in the right environment.

word_of_the_day.meaning: The use of peaceful means, not force, to bring about political or social change.
word_of_the_day.example: Mahatma Gandhi's principle of nonviolence inspired civil rights movements across the globe.

today_in_history.fact: October 2 marks the birth anniversary of Mahatma Gandhi, celebrated globally as the International Day of Non-Violence.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? A single fluffy cumulus cloud can weigh over a million pounds.

quote_of_the_day.quote: In a gentle way, you can shake the world.
quote_of_the_day.author: Mahatma Gandhi

paheli.question: If you drop me I'm sure to crack, but give me a smile and I'll always smile back. What am I?

dialogue: Wife: I have changed my mind.
Husband: Thank goodness! Does the new one work better?

prerak_kahani.title: The Obstacle in Our Path
prerak_kahani.story: A king placed a heavy boulder on a roadway and hid to see who would move it. Many wealthy merchants simply walked around it, blaming the king for not keeping the roads clear. Finally, a peasant came along. He pushed and strained until he rolled the boulder away. Beneath it, he found a purse filled with gold coins and a note from the king explaining that the gold was for whoever cleared the path.
prerak_kahani.moral: Every obstacle presents an opportunity to improve our condition.

word_of_the_day.meaning: A thing that blocks one's way or prevents or hinders progress.
word_of_the_day.example: A lack of funds was a major obstacle to the completion of the project.

today_in_history.fact: On October 3, 1990, East and West Germany were officially reunified after decades of Cold War division.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? Cows do not have any upper front teeth. Instead, they press their bottom teeth against a hard palate on the top of their mouth to cut grass.

quote_of_the_day.quote: If you want to lift yourself up, lift up someone else.
quote_of_the_day.author: Booker T. Washington

paheli.question: What has one head, one foot, and four legs?

dialogue: Doctor: I told you to eat an apple every day to keep the doctor away. Why are you here?
Patient: I missed a day!

prerak_kahani.title: The Frog in the Well
prerak_kahani.story: A frog lived all its life in a deep well. It thought the well was the entire world. One day, a turtle from the ocean fell into the well. The frog boasted about his massive kingdom. The turtle laughed and described the endless, gigantic ocean. The frog got angry, refusing to believe that anything could be bigger than his well.
prerak_kahani.moral: Don't let your limited experience become your absolute truth. Keep an open mind to the vastness of the world.

word_of_the_day.meaning: Without end, limit, or boundary.
word_of_the_day.example: With a good education and a strong work ethic, your potential is limitless.

today_in_history.fact: On October 4, 1957, the Soviet Union launched Sputnik 1, the first artificial Earth satellite, initiating the Space Age.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? Banging your head against a wall for one hour burns about 150 calories.

quote_of_the_day.quote: You miss 100% of the shots you don't take.
quote_of_the_day.author: Wayne Gretzky

paheli.question: What can you break, even if you never pick it up or touch it?

dialogue: Kid 1: Are you good at math?
Kid 2: Yes, I am.
Kid 1: Okay, what is 5 plus 4?
Kid 2: 9.
Kid 1: What is 4 plus 5?
Kid 2: Are you trying to trick me? You just flipped it. It's an upside-down 9, which is 6!

prerak_kahani.title: The Starfish Thrower
prerak_kahani.story: An old man was walking on a beach covered with thousands of stranded starfish. He saw a boy picking them up one by one and tossing them back into the ocean. The man said, 'Son, there are too many. You can't possibly make a difference.' The boy picked up another starfish, threw it into the water, and smiled, 'I made a difference for that one.'
prerak_kahani.moral: You might not be able to change the whole world, but you can change the world for one person.

word_of_the_day.meaning: Have a strong effect on someone or something.
word_of_the_day.example: The inspirational seminar had a huge impact on her career choices.

today_in_history.fact: October 5 is celebrated globally as World Teachers' Day, recognizing the critical role teachers play in society.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? Water covers about 71% of the Earth's surface, yet only a tiny fraction of it is fresh water we can drink.

quote_of_the_day.quote: Be yourself; everyone else is already taken.
quote_of_the_day.author: Oscar Wilde

paheli.question: What has a neck but no head?

dialogue: Police: Why did you break into the same store three nights in a row?
Thief: Because I stole a dress for my wife on the first night, and she made me go back to exchange it for a different size the next two nights!

prerak_kahani.title: The Two Seeds
prerak_kahani.story: Two seeds lay in the fertile soil. The first said, 'I want to grow! I want to push my roots deep and my sprouts high.' It grew into a strong plant. The second seed said, 'I am afraid. If I push into the hard dirt, I might hurt myself. If I bloom, a bug might eat me. I will wait until it is safe.' It waited and waited, until a passing hen scratched the ground and ate it.
prerak_kahani.moral: Fear of the unknown and refusal to take risks will keep you from fulfilling your potential.

word_of_the_day.meaning: A strong desire to do or to achieve something, typically requiring determination and hard work.
word_of_the_day.example: Her ambition is to become the best surgeon in the country.

today_in_history.fact: On October 6, 2010, the photo-sharing app Instagram was officially launched on the App Store.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? Percy Spencer, the man who invented the microwave oven, only received $2 from his company as a reward for his groundbreaking discovery.

quote_of_the_day.quote: Everything you've ever wanted is on the other side of fear.
quote_of_the_day.author: George Addair

paheli.question: Forward I am heavy, backward I am not. What am I?

dialogue: Customer: This coffee tastes like mud!
Waiter: Well sir, it was ground this morning.

prerak_kahani.title: The Butterfly's Struggle
prerak_kahani.story: A man saw a butterfly struggling to emerge from its cocoon. Wanting to help, he took a pair of scissors and snipped the cocoon open. The butterfly emerged easily but had a swollen body and shriveled wings. It could never fly. The man didn't realize that the struggle to get through the tiny opening was nature's way of forcing fluid from the body into the wings.
prerak_kahani.moral: Struggles develop our strength. Without them, we never grow into who we are meant to be.

word_of_the_day.meaning: Make forceful or violent efforts to get free of restraint or constriction.
word_of_the_day.example: Despite the harsh struggle, the team managed to secure a victory.

today_in_history.fact: On October 7, 1919, KLM, the flag carrier airline of the Netherlands, was founded. It is the oldest airline still operating under its original name.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? A blue whale's tongue is so massive that it weighs as much as an entire elephant.

quote_of_the_day.quote: Strength and growth come only through continuous effort and struggle.
quote_of_the_day.author: Napoleon Hill

paheli.question: I can be cracked, made, told, and played. What am I?

dialogue: Father: Why did you sleep with a ruler under your pillow?
Son: To see how long I slept!

prerak_kahani.title: The Wise Owl
prerak_kahani.story: There was an old owl who lived in an oak tree. Every day, he saw incidents happening around him. Yesterday, he watched as a young boy helped an old man carry a heavy basket. Today, he saw a young girl shouting at her mother. The more he saw, the less he spoke. As the days went on, he spoke less but heard more. The old owl became known as the wisest bird in the forest.
prerak_kahani.moral: Talk less and listen more. Observation and listening make you wiser.

word_of_the_day.meaning: Notice or perceive something and register it as being significant.
word_of_the_day.example: Scientists carefully observe the behavior of animals in their natural habitats.

today_in_history.fact: On October 8, 1932, the Indian Air Force (IAF) was officially established.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? It takes a sloth up to two weeks to completely digest a single meal.

quote_of_the_day.quote: A wise man can learn more from a foolish question than a fool can learn from a wise answer.
quote_of_the_day.author: Bruce Lee

paheli.question: What is so fragile that simply saying its name breaks it?

dialogue: Boss: I need someone who can type 100 words a minute, and doesn't get distracted.
Employee: I'm perfect for the job! I can type 100 words a minute... they just might not be the right words.

prerak_kahani.title: The Farmer and the Rock
prerak_kahani.story: A farmer had a large rock in the middle of his field. For years, he broke his plow blades on it and wasted time steering around it. He was always angry at the rock. One day, fed up, he grabbed a crowbar, expecting a massive task. To his surprise, the rock was only a few inches thick. He easily pried it out. The obstacle he had feared and avoided for years was actually a minor problem.
prerak_kahani.moral: Face your problems directly instead of avoiding them. Often, they are smaller than you think.

word_of_the_day.meaning: Meet a problem or difficulty face to face with hostile or argumentative intent.
word_of_the_day.example: It is better to confront your fears rather than run away from them.

today_in_history.fact: October 9 is recognized as World Post Day, marking the anniversary of the establishment of the Universal Postal Union in 1874.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? In the 1830s, ketchup was sold in pharmacies as a medicine to cure indigestion and diarrhea.

quote_of_the_day.quote: The secret of getting ahead is getting started.
quote_of_the_day.author: Mark Twain

paheli.question: What gets sharper the more you use it?

dialogue: Friend 1: Why did the boy throw his clock out the window?
Friend 2: Why?
Friend 1: Because he wanted to see time fly!

prerak_kahani.title: The Blind Boy and the Sign
prerak_kahani.story: A blind boy sat with a sign that read, 'I am blind, please help.' He only had a few coins in his hat. A man walked by, turned the sign over, wrote something, and left. Suddenly, people began dropping coins rapidly into the hat. The boy recognized the man's footsteps later and asked what he wrote. The man replied, 'I wrote the truth, just in a different way.' The sign now read: 'Today is a beautiful day, and I cannot see it.'
prerak_kahani.moral: A change of perspective and a choice of better words can change your entire situation.

word_of_the_day.meaning: The action or fact of persuading someone or of being persuaded to do or believe something.
word_of_the_day.example: It took a lot of persuasion to convince him to take a vacation.

today_in_history.fact: October 10 is observed globally as World Mental Health Day, aiming to raise awareness and mobilize efforts in support of mental health.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? The human nose is an incredible organ that can remember up to 50,000 different scents.

quote_of_the_day.quote: Words have the power to both destroy and heal. When words are both true and kind, they can change our world.
quote_of_the_day.author: Buddha

paheli.question: What is always in front of you but can never be seen?

dialogue: Mom: Why did you swallow the coins I gave you for lunch?
Son: Because you said it was my lunch money!

prerak_kahani.title: The Pot of Gold
prerak_kahani.story: A lazy man heard a rumor that a pot of gold was buried under a specific mountain. He sold his farm, bought climbing gear, and spent his life digging holes on the mountain. He died poor and exhausted. Meanwhile, the man who bought his farm started planting crops. Within a few years, the farm yielded so much profit that the new owner became wealthy enough to buy a pot of gold.
prerak_kahani.moral: Stop looking for shortcuts. True wealth and success come from hard work and utilizing the resources you already have.

word_of_the_day.meaning: Diligent and hard-working.
word_of_the_day.example: The industrious ants worked all summer to store food for the winter.

today_in_history.fact: On October 11, 1968, NASA launched Apollo 7, the first crewed mission in the Apollo space program.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? An ant's sense of smell is incredibly sensitive, often stronger than that of a dog.

quote_of_the_day.quote: The future belongs to those who believe in the beauty of their dreams.
quote_of_the_day.author: Eleanor Roosevelt

paheli.question: What can fill a room but takes up no physical space?

dialogue: Passenger: Do you mind if I put my pizza on the seat next to me?
Driver: Not at all, as long as it's wearing a seatbelt!

prerak_kahani.title: The Real Wealth
prerak_kahani.story: A wealthy father took his son on a trip to a village to show him how poor people live. They spent a day on a very poor farm. On the way back, the father asked, 'Did you see how poor they are?' The son replied, 'Yes. We have one dog, they have four. We have a pool, they have a massive river. We buy our food, they grow theirs. We have walls to protect us, they have friends.' The father was speechless.
prerak_kahani.moral: Wealth isn't just about money. True wealth is found in nature, family, friends, and contentment.

word_of_the_day.meaning: A state of happiness and satisfaction.
word_of_the_day.example: He found great contentment in living a simple, quiet life.

today_in_history.fact: On October 12, 1492, Italian explorer Christopher Columbus arrived in the Americas, landing in the Bahamas.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? Strawberries are the only fruit that bear their seeds on the outside.

quote_of_the_day.quote: Wealth consists not in having great possessions, but in having few wants.
quote_of_the_day.author: Epictetus

paheli.question: If you've got me, you want to share me; if you share me, you haven't kept me. What am I?

dialogue: Patient: Doctor, I think I need glasses.
Doctor: You certainly do, sir. You've walked into a bakery!

prerak_kahani.title: The Donkey in the Well
prerak_kahani.story: A farmer's donkey fell into a dry well. The farmer decided the donkey was old and the well needed to be covered anyway, so he started shoveling dirt in to bury the donkey. At first, the donkey cried terribly. But then, he did something amazing. Every time dirt landed on his back, he shook it off and took a step up. Eventually, he stepped right over the edge and trotted away.
prerak_kahani.moral: Life will throw dirt at you. The trick to getting out of the well is to shake it off and take a step up.

word_of_the_day.meaning: Difficulties; misfortune.
word_of_the_day.example: They showed incredible strength and stayed united in the face of adversity.

today_in_history.fact: On October 13, 1792, the cornerstone of the United States Executive Mansion, now known as the White House, was laid.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? A group of owls is called a parliament.

quote_of_the_day.quote: Our greatest glory is not in never falling, but in rising every time we fall.
quote_of_the_day.author: Confucius

paheli.question: What runs all around a backyard, yet never moves?

dialogue: Teacher: Please point to America on the map.
Student: *Points* Here it is.
Teacher: Correct. Now class, who discovered America?
Class: Our classmate did!

prerak_kahani.title: The Proud Red Rose
prerak_kahani.story: A beautiful red rose blossomed in a forest and was very proud of her looks. She constantly insulted a cactus growing nearby for being ugly. The cactus never replied. Summer came, the well dried up, and the rose began to wilt. She saw a bird dip its beak into the cactus to drink water. Ashamed, the rose asked the cactus for help. The kind cactus agreed, and the birds watered both plants.
prerak_kahani.moral: Never judge anyone by their appearance. Even the most unimpressive things have great value.

word_of_the_day.meaning: A modest or low view of one's own importance; humbleness.
word_of_the_day.example: Despite his immense success and wealth, he always behaved with remarkable humility.

today_in_history.fact: On October 14, 1947, U.S. Air Force Captain Chuck Yeager became the first person to fly faster than the speed of sound.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? Pineapples do not grow on trees; they grow on a leafy plant close to the ground, and it takes about two years for a single pineapple to grow.

quote_of_the_day.quote: Pride makes us artificial and humility makes us real.
quote_of_the_day.author: Thomas Merton

paheli.question: What goes through cities and fields, but never moves?

dialogue: Daughter: Dad, can you put my shoes on?
Dad: No, I don't think they'll fit me.

prerak_kahani.title: The Monk and the Scorpion
prerak_kahani.story: A monk was bathing in a river when he saw a scorpion drowning. He picked it up to save it, but the scorpion stung his hand. He dropped it back into the river. He tried again, and again it stung him. A bystander asked, 'Why do you keep trying to save it when it keeps stinging you?' The monk replied, 'It is the scorpion's nature to sting. But it is my nature to save. Why should I give up my good nature just because it has a bad one?'
prerak_kahani.moral: Do not let the bad behavior of others change your inner goodness.

word_of_the_day.meaning: The quality of being morally right or justifiable.
word_of_the_day.example: He was respected by everyone because he always walked the path of righteousness.

today_in_history.fact: October 15 is celebrated as World Students' Day in honor of the birth anniversary of Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam, the 11th President of India.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? According to astronauts, outer space smells like a mixture of seared steak, hot metal, and welding fumes.

quote_of_the_day.quote: Dream, dream, dream. Dreams transform into thoughts and thoughts result in action.
quote_of_the_day.author: A.P.J. Abdul Kalam

paheli.question: I have an eye but cannot see. I am faster than any man, yet I have no limbs. What am I?

dialogue: Friend 1: Why did the computer squeak?
Friend 2: I don't know, why?
Friend 1: Because someone stepped on its mouse!

prerak_kahani.title: The Fox and the Crow
prerak_kahani.story: A crow found a piece of cheese and sat on a branch to eat it. A hungry fox saw him and wanted the cheese. The fox walked up to the tree and started praising the crow's beauty, saying, 'If your voice is as beautiful as your feathers, you must be the king of birds! Please sing for me.' Flattered, the crow opened his beak to caw, dropping the cheese right into the fox's mouth.
prerak_kahani.moral: Beware of flatterers; they often have a hidden agenda.

word_of_the_day.meaning: Admirably purposeful, determined, and unwavering.
word_of_the_day.example: She was resolute in her decision to finish the marathon despite the heavy rain.

today_in_history.fact: On October 16, 1923, Walt Disney and his brother Roy founded the Disney Brothers Cartoon Studio, now known as The Walt Disney Company.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? Kangaroos cannot walk backwards because of the structure of their hind legs and heavy tails.

quote_of_the_day.quote: If you can dream it, you can do it.
quote_of_the_day.author: Walt Disney

paheli.question: What goes up when the rain comes down?

dialogue: Customer: I'd like to order a bowl of soup.
Waiter: We only have one bowl left, and the skeleton at the next table ordered it.
Customer: Why hasn't he eaten it?
Waiter: He doesn't have the stomach for it!

prerak_kahani.title: The Man and the Little Cat
prerak_kahani.story: A man saw a kitten stuck in a deep puddle, struggling to get out. He reached in to save it, but the terrified kitten scratched his hand. The man pulled his hand back in pain but immediately reached in again to rescue the kitten. A bystander asked, 'Why keep trying when it keeps hurting you?' The man replied, 'It is the cat's nature to scratch out of fear, but it is my nature to help and love.'
prerak_kahani.moral: Never change your good heart and kindness just because someone reacts poorly out of fear or pain.

word_of_the_day.meaning: Feelings of pity and sorrow for someone else's misfortune.
word_of_the_day.example: They offered their deepest sympathy to the family after their loss.

today_in_history.fact: On October 17, 1979, Mother Teresa was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize for her work in bringing help to suffering humanity.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? The Venus flytrap is a carnivorous plant that can count. It waits for an insect to touch its trigger hairs twice before snapping shut.

quote_of_the_day.quote: Kind words can be short and easy to speak, but their echoes are truly endless.
quote_of_the_day.author: Mother Teresa

paheli.question: I am always hungry, I must always be fed. The finger I touch, will soon turn red. What am I?

dialogue: Teacher: Name an animal that lives in Lapland.
Student: A reindeer.
Teacher: Good. Now name another.
Student: Another reindeer!

prerak_kahani.title: The Magic Pot
prerak_kahani.story: A poor farmer dug up a large brass pot in his field. He threw his spade inside it and went to rest. When he returned, there were two spades in the pot. Realizing it was magical and doubled whatever was put inside, he started doubling his grains and became wealthy. One day, his greedy landlord found out, stole the pot, and looked inside. He slipped and fell in, and soon there were two greedy landlords fighting over the pot until it broke.
prerak_kahani.moral: Greed destroys everything it touches. Be satisfied with what you have.

word_of_the_day.meaning: Sparing or economical with regard to money or food.
word_of_the_day.example: By living a frugal lifestyle, she was able to save enough to buy a house.

today_in_history.fact: On October 18, 1922, the British Broadcasting Company (BBC) was founded.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? Koalas sleep for up to 22 hours a day because their diet of eucalyptus leaves requires a lot of energy to digest.

quote_of_the_day.quote: To live is the rarest thing in the world. Most people exist, that is all.
quote_of_the_day.author: Oscar Wilde

paheli.question: I fly without wings. I cry without eyes. Wherever I go, darkness flies. What am I?

dialogue: Patient: I am invisible!
Receptionist: I'm sorry, the doctor can't see you right now.

prerak_kahani.title: The Fox Without a Tail
prerak_kahani.story: A fox got his tail caught in a trap and had to pull it off to escape. Feeling ashamed of his appearance, he called a meeting of all the other foxes. He argued that tails were ugly, heavy, and a burden, and suggested they all cut theirs off too. An older, wiser fox stood up and said, 'You wouldn't be giving us this advice if you still had your own tail.'
prerak_kahani.moral: Do not listen to the advice of someone who is only looking to make you share their own misfortune.

word_of_the_day.meaning: Clever, original, and inventive.
word_of_the_day.example: He came up with an ingenious solution to the complex engineering problem.

today_in_history.fact: On October 19, 1781, British General Lord Cornwallis surrendered at Yorktown, effectively ending the American Revolutionary War.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? Polar bears actually have black skin under their white fur to help absorb heat from the sun.

quote_of_the_day.quote: Learn from yesterday, live for today, hope for tomorrow.
quote_of_the_day.author: Albert Einstein

paheli.question: I have hands but cannot hold a thing. I have a face but cannot smile. What am I?

dialogue: Son: Mom, the teacher at school is cross-eyed!
Mom: That's not nice to say. Why do you think that?
Son: Because she has no control over her pupils!

prerak_kahani.title: The Elephant and the Friends
prerak_kahani.story: A lonely elephant wandered into a new forest looking for friends. He asked a monkey, a rabbit, and a frog, but they all said he was too big to play their games. The next day, a tiger was terrorizing the forest animals. The elephant stepped in front of the tiger and told him to leave his friends alone, scaring the tiger away. The animals cheered and said, 'You are just the right size to be our friend!'
prerak_kahani.moral: True friendship does not look at size, appearance, or background, but at the kindness of one's heart.

word_of_the_day.meaning: Fond of company; sociable.
word_of_the_day.example: Dolphins are highly gregarious animals, living in large social pods.

today_in_history.fact: On October 20, 1973, the Sydney Opera House was officially opened by Queen Elizabeth II.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? A flea can jump up to 200 times its own body height. That is equivalent to a human jumping over the Empire State Building.

quote_of_the_day.quote: Whatever you are, be a good one.
quote_of_the_day.author: Abraham Lincoln

paheli.question: I have 88 keys, but I cannot open a single door. What am I?

dialogue: Fish 1: Are you okay?
Fish 2: I have no idea how to drive this tank!

prerak_kahani.title: The Peacock and the Crane
prerak_kahani.story: A peacock spread his beautiful, colorful tail and mocked a crane passing by. 'Look at my spectacular feathers,' he boasted. 'Your feathers are completely grey and boring.' The crane calmly replied, 'Your feathers may be more beautiful, but my grey wings can carry me high up into the sky and among the stars, while your beautiful feathers keep you stuck down here in the dirt.'
prerak_kahani.moral: Usefulness is far more valuable than mere physical beauty.

word_of_the_day.meaning: Dealing with things sensibly and realistically in a way that is based on practical rather than theoretical considerations.
word_of_the_day.example: He took a pragmatic approach to solving the budget crisis.

today_in_history.fact: On October 21, 1879, Thomas Edison successfully tested the first practical incandescent light bulb.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? A giraffe's tongue is dark blue or black, which helps prevent it from getting sunburned while eating leaves.

quote_of_the_day.quote: I have not failed. I've just found 10,000 ways that won't work.
quote_of_the_day.author: Thomas A. Edison

paheli.question: Where does today come before yesterday?

dialogue: Vegetable 1: Why did the tomato turn red?
Vegetable 2: Because it saw the salad dressing!

prerak_kahani.title: The Oak and the Reeds
prerak_kahani.story: A giant, proud oak tree stood near a river, surrounded by thin, fragile reeds. A massive storm hit the valley. The oak tree stood rigid, fighting the powerful winds, until it finally snapped and fell over. The reeds, however, simply bent over to the ground with the wind. When the storm passed, they stood right back up unharmed. The oak learned too late that flexibility is a strength.
prerak_kahani.moral: It is better to yield and adapt to overwhelming circumstances than to remain rigid and be broken.

word_of_the_day.meaning: Showing great attention to detail; very careful and precise.
word_of_the_day.example: The artist was extremely meticulous in painting the tiny details of the portrait.

today_in_history.fact: On October 22, 1797, André-Jacques Garnerin made the first recorded parachute jump from a hydrogen balloon.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? The fingerprints of a koala are so indistinguishable from human fingerprints that they have occasionally confused crime scene investigators.

quote_of_the_day.quote: Character cannot be developed in ease and quiet. Only through experience of trial and suffering can the soul be strengthened.
quote_of_the_day.author: Helen Keller

paheli.question: I can be cracked, but never broken. I can be told, but never spoken. What am I?

dialogue: Farmer 1: Why do cows have hooves instead of feet?
Farmer 2: I don't know, why?
Farmer 1: Because they lactose!

prerak_kahani.title: The Hound and the Hare
prerak_kahani.story: A hunting hound chased a hare for a long time but eventually gave up and let the hare escape. A goat watching nearby mocked the hound, saying, 'That little creature is much faster than you!' The hound replied, 'You don't understand the difference. I was only running for my dinner, but he was running for his life.'
prerak_kahani.moral: Motivation matters. When your life or core purpose is on the line, your efforts are far greater.

word_of_the_day.meaning: Tending to keep a firm hold of something; clinging or adhering closely.
word_of_the_day.example: The tenacious detective refused to close the case until it was fully solved.

today_in_history.fact: On October 23, 2001, Apple introduced the first iPod, revolutionizing how the world listened to music.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? A flock of crows is known as a 'murder' of crows.

quote_of_the_day.quote: Innovation distinguishes between a leader and a follower.
quote_of_the_day.author: Steve Jobs

paheli.question: I have four fingers and a thumb, but I have no flesh or bone. What am I?

dialogue: Kid 1: Why don't skeletons ever fight each other?
Kid 2: Why?
Kid 1: Because they don't have the guts!

prerak_kahani.title: The Miser and His Gold
prerak_kahani.story: A miser sold everything he had and bought a lump of gold, which he buried in a hole in the ground by an old wall. Every day he went to look at it. One day, a thief noticed him, dug up the gold, and stole it. When the miser found it missing, he tore his hair in grief. A neighbor said, 'Don't cry. Just put a stone in the hole and look at it every day. It will do you just as much good, since you never planned to spend the gold anyway.'
prerak_kahani.moral: Wealth is only useful if it is used. Hoarding it has no value.

word_of_the_day.meaning: Showing a disinterested and selfless concern for the well-being of others; unselfish.
word_of_the_day.example: His altruistic actions saved the community center from shutting down.

today_in_history.fact: On October 24, 1945, the United Nations was officially established after a majority of its founding members ratified a treaty.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? Pigeons are capable of doing basic math and distinguishing between different artists' paintings.

quote_of_the_day.quote: The only thing we have to fear is fear itself.
quote_of_the_day.author: Franklin D. Roosevelt

paheli.question: What has to be broken before you can use it?

dialogue: Cookie 1: Why did you go to the hospital yesterday?
Cookie 2: Because I felt crummy!

prerak_kahani.title: The Frogs Who Desired a King
prerak_kahani.story: A group of frogs lived freely in a pond, but they decided they wanted a king to rule over them. They prayed to the gods. The gods found it silly and dropped a heavy log into the pond. At first, the frogs were terrified, but soon they realized the log didn't do anything and started jumping on it. Unhappy, they prayed for a 'real' king. The gods, annoyed, sent a crane. The crane quickly started eating the frogs one by one.
prerak_kahani.moral: Be careful what you wish for. Sometimes it is better to have no ruler than a cruel one.

word_of_the_day.meaning: Able to recoil or spring back into shape after bending, stretching, or being compressed.
word_of_the_day.example: The economy proved to be highly resilient following the global crisis.

today_in_history.fact: On October 25, 1881, Pablo Picasso, one of the greatest and most influential artists of the 20th century, was born.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? The human body contains enough iron to make a small metal nail.

quote_of_the_day.quote: Action is the foundational key to all success.
quote_of_the_day.author: Pablo Picasso

paheli.question: What has a bottom at the top?

dialogue: Friend 1: What do you call a lazy kangaroo?
Friend 2: I don't know.
Friend 1: A pouch potato!

prerak_kahani.title: Belling the Cat
prerak_kahani.story: A family of mice lived in fear of a stealthy cat. They held a council to figure out how to outsmart her. A young mouse suggested tying a bell around the cat's neck so they could hear her coming. All the mice cheered and agreed it was a brilliant plan. Then, an old, wise mouse stood up and said, 'That is a wonderful idea. But tell me, who is going to put the bell on the cat?' The room went silent.
prerak_kahani.moral: It is easy to propose impossible solutions. Executing them is the real challenge.

word_of_the_day.meaning: Fluent or persuasive in speaking or writing.
word_of_the_day.example: She delivered an eloquent speech that moved the entire audience to tears.

today_in_history.fact: On October 26, 1979, the World Health Organization announced the global eradication of smallpox.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? A day on Earth is not exactly 24 hours. It takes the Earth 23 hours, 56 minutes, and 4 seconds to rotate on its axis.

quote_of_the_day.quote: Knowing yourself is the beginning of all wisdom.
quote_of_the_day.author: Aristotle

paheli.question: I am taken from a mine, and shut up in a wooden case, from which I am never released. Yet I am used by almost everybody. What am I?

dialogue: Son: Dad, do you know any good elevator jokes?
Dad: I do, but they work on many levels.

prerak_kahani.title: The Dog in the Manger
prerak_kahani.story: A dog was looking for a comfortable place to sleep and jumped into a manger full of hay meant for the farm horses. When the tired, hungry horses returned from the fields, the dog barked fiercely and snapped at them, refusing to let them eat the hay. The horses said, 'What a selfish creature! He cannot eat the hay himself, yet he won't let those who actually need it have it.'
prerak_kahani.moral: Do not grudge others what you cannot enjoy yourself.

word_of_the_day.meaning: Having or showing care and conscientiousness in one's work or duties.
word_of_the_day.example: He is a very diligent student, always completing his assignments on time.

today_in_history.fact: On October 27, 1904, the first underground line of the New York City Subway opened.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? Dolphins use a unique whistle to identify each other, essentially giving themselves names.

quote_of_the_day.quote: No one can make you feel inferior without your consent.
quote_of_the_day.author: Eleanor Roosevelt

paheli.question: Take off my skin and I won't cry, but you will! What am I?

dialogue: Golfer 1: Why did you bring two pairs of pants to the golf course?
Golfer 2: In case I got a hole in one!

prerak_kahani.title: The Wolf in Sheep's Clothing
prerak_kahani.story: A wolf found a stray sheepskin and put it on to disguise himself. He slipped into a flock of sheep grazing in a pasture. The shepherd was entirely fooled. When night fell, the shepherd locked the wolf in the fold with the rest of the sheep. However, the shepherd wanted mutton for his dinner. He went in, grabbed a 'sheep' in the dark, and accidentally killed the wolf.
prerak_kahani.moral: Deceit often turns back on the deceiver. The evil you plan for others may end up destroying you.

word_of_the_day.meaning: Keeping careful watch for possible danger or difficulties.
word_of_the_day.example: The security guard remained vigilant throughout his night shift.

today_in_history.fact: On October 28, 1886, the Statue of Liberty was officially dedicated in New York Harbor by President Grover Cleveland.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? Armadillos have shells so tough that they are essentially bulletproof.

quote_of_the_day.quote: Give me your tired, your poor, your huddled masses yearning to breathe free.
quote_of_the_day.author: Emma Lazarus

paheli.question: Tear one off and scratch my head, what was red is black instead. What am I?

dialogue: Kid 1: What do you call a sleeping dinosaur?
Kid 2: What?
Kid 1: A dino-snore!

prerak_kahani.title: The Fox and the Goat
prerak_kahani.story: A fox fell into a deep well and couldn't get out. A thirsty goat walked by and asked if the water was good. The fox lied, 'It is the best water I've ever tasted! Jump in!' The goat jumped in without thinking. The fox immediately stepped on the goat's back, leaped out of the well, and ran away, leaving the foolish goat trapped.
prerak_kahani.moral: Look before you leap. Do not blindly trust the advice of someone who is in trouble themselves.

word_of_the_day.meaning: Showing a willingness to take surprisingly bold risks.
word_of_the_day.example: The team came up with an audacious plan to completely rebrand the company in just one month.

today_in_history.fact: On October 29, 1969, the first message was sent over ARPANET, laying the foundational groundwork for the modern Internet.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? Owls don't have eyeballs. They have tube-shaped eyes that are locked into their skulls, which is why they must turn their heads to see.

quote_of_the_day.quote: It's fine to celebrate success but it is more important to heed the lessons of failure.
quote_of_the_day.author: Bill Gates

paheli.question: What can run but never walks, has a mouth but never talks, has a head but never weeps, has a bed but never sleeps?

dialogue: Police: Why did the picture go to jail?
Thief: Because it was framed!

prerak_kahani.title: The Milkmaid and Her Pail
prerak_kahani.story: A milkmaid was carrying a pail of milk on her head. As she walked, she daydreamed: 'I will sell this milk and buy eggs. The eggs will hatch into chickens. I'll sell the chickens and buy a beautiful dress to wear to the dance. All the boys will want to dance with me, but I will toss my head and say no.' Swept up in the thought, she tossed her head. The pail fell, and all the milk spilled onto the ground.
prerak_kahani.moral: Do not count your chickens before they hatch. Focus on the present work rather than daydreaming about future rewards.

word_of_the_day.meaning: Acting with or showing care and thought for the future.
word_of_the_day.example: It is always prudent to save a portion of your salary for emergencies.

today_in_history.fact: On October 30, 1938, Orson Welles broadcasted a radio play of 'The War of the Worlds,' causing widespread panic as listeners believed a real alien invasion was happening.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? The unicorn is the official national animal of Scotland.

quote_of_the_day.quote: We're born alone, we live alone, we die alone. Only through our love and friendship can we create the illusion for the moment that we're not alone.
quote_of_the_day.author: Orson Welles

paheli.question: I have no body, but I can open doors. I have no voice, but I can make people scream. What am I?

dialogue: Kid 1: What rests on the bottom of the ocean and shakes?
Kid 2: A nervous wreck!

prerak_kahani.title: The Town Mouse and the Country Mouse
prerak_kahani.story: A town mouse visited his cousin in the country and laughed at the simple food of roots and wheat. He invited his cousin to the city. There, they ate from a grand feast of cheese, fruit, and honey. But right in the middle of their meal, dogs barked and humans rushed in, sending the mice running in terror. The country mouse packed his bags and left, saying, 'Better beans and bacon in peace than cakes and ale in fear.'
prerak_kahani.moral: A simple, peaceful life is far better than a luxurious one filled with danger and stress.

word_of_the_day.meaning: Difficult or impossible to understand, explain, or identify.
word_of_the_day.example: A mysterious old map was found in the attic of the haunted house.

today_in_history.fact: On October 31, 1941, the monumental carving of Mount Rushmore in South Dakota was declared complete.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? Pumpkins are technically classified as fruits, not vegetables, because they contain seeds and develop from the flower of a plant.

quote_of_the_day.quote: Monsters are real, and ghosts are real too. They live inside us, and sometimes, they win.
quote_of_the_day.author: Stephen King
